source_interpretation.finding: kPadSeqLenK forces bias alignment to one and enables edge masking. Disabling K padding alone provides most of the observed speedup. Q padding and output padding alone have little effect. This does not isolate each generated instruction cost.
source_interpretation.v_layout: RowMajor; do not attribute this candidate speedup to the separate ColumnMajor V alignment branch.

limitations: Random exact-shape inputs and FP32 numerical agreement do not establish model accuracy or speed.
Group-of-eight measurements are per-call GPU throughput, not a cold request latency.
The integrated candidate uses standard CK grid scheduling and physical bias padding 16; grouped probe timings are separate.
N1000 is not divisible by these sequence tiles and retains its existing padded instantiation.
